changeSet.author: arena
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

changeSet.author: arena
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, login TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() );

changeSet.author: arena
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE user_bots ( user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, bot_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), PRIMARY KEY (user_id, bot_name) );
